name: docker-compose
description: Multi-container orchestration with service dependency management

tools.description: YAML-based multi-container orchestration with networking and volumes
tools.usage:
docker-compose up -d --build # Build and run in background
docker-compose logs -f webapp # Follow specific service logs
docker-compose exec web bash # Interactive shell in service
docker-compose down --volumes --remove-orphans # Clean shutdown
docker-compose scale worker=3 # Scale service to 3 replicas
